svg.title: PL subsystem architecture: Zynq PS and FPGA PL
svg.desc: Editable vector diagram of a generic BVSTK PS-PL subsystem. The diagram is organized into Zynq PS, subsystem services, OS adapters, MMIO, and FPGA PL.

g.inkscape:label: MMIO connections
g.title: MMIO connections from PL-core driver to FPGA PL
g.desc: Both OS-specific PL-core driver variants connect to a common MMIO bus. The bus fans out to pl_slave and pl_master. Edit these paths to change routing.
